ns2:course.label: Foundations of Data Management
ns2:course.description: An introduction to basic data management concepts and programming skills necessary for analyzing data in actuarial and financial applications. Students are expected to learn how to store, clean, explore and analyze data using a programming language and statistical software. Prerequisite: For actuarial science majors only. For freshman only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: For actuarial science majors only. For freshman only.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
